name: Argentina
inflation_note: ARS amounts are indicative for Q1-2025. Argentina applies quarterly CPI adjustments (Ley 27.609). Verify current amounts at anses.gob.ar.

aids.nom: AUH — Asignación Universal por Hijo para Protección Social
aids.description_en: Universal Child Allowance (AUH) — monthly cash transfer of approximately ARS 70,000 per child under 18 (or disabled child of any age) for unemployed, informal, or low-income workers. 80% paid monthly; 20% withheld and released annually upon proof of school attendance and vaccination. Amounts updated quarterly by ANSES.
aids.organisme: ANSES — Administración Nacional de la Seguridad Social

aids.description_en: Unemployment insurance managed by ANSES for formal-sector workers dismissed without just cause. Duration: 2 to 12 months depending on years of contribution. Amount: 70% of last salary for the first 4 months, then stepped down. Range approximately ARS 17,400–52,300/month in early 2025 (minimum/maximum). Requires minimum 6 months of contributions in last 3 years.
aids.organisme: ANSES — Administración Nacional de la Seguridad Social

aids.description_en: Minimum contributory old-age pension (haber mínimo) under the SIPA system. Approximately ARS 302,000/month in early 2025 (subject to quarterly RIPTE-based adjustments). Requires minimum 30 years of contributions and age 65 (men) or 60 (women). Updated by ANSES four times per year.
aids.organisme: ANSES — Administración Nacional de la Seguridad Social

aids.nom: PNC por Invalidez — Pensión No Contributiva
aids.description_en: Non-contributory disability pension (PNC por Invalidez) for Argentine nationals aged 18 or over with a disability of 76% or more, without sufficient income or assets, and without access to a contributory pension. Amount approximately ARS 226,500/month in early 2025 (75% of the minimum pension). Updated quarterly.

Food card for families receiving AUH or Pregnancy Allowance (AUE) with children under 14. Approximately ARS 60,000–120,000/month depending on number of qualifying children. Can only be used to purchase food at authorized stores. Part of the Argentina Contra el Hambre program.

Monthly educational stipend for students aged 18 to 24 (or any age for vocational/secondary education) from low-income households. Approximately ARS 15,000/month for higher education track in early 2025. Students must maintain academic progress and meet attendance requirements. Managed by Secretaría de Educación.

Employment and social inclusion program offering a monthly economic incentive equal to 50% of the minimum wage (approximately ARS 151,600/month in early 2025) to unemployed workers in vulnerable situations who participate in work integration or training activities. Aimed at strengthening family and community socio-economic units.

Maternity benefit for female workers in formal employment. Paid for 90 days (45 days before and 45 days after birth, or all 90 days post-birth). Amount equals the worker's full salary at time of leave. Paid by ANSES and then reimbursed by the employer. No ceiling for public-sector workers; private sector ceiling applies.
aids.organisme: ANSES — Administración Nacional de la Seguridad Social

aids.description_en: Contributory family allowance per child for formal-sector workers, paid through the SUAF (Sistema Único de Asignaciones Familiares). Amount varies by worker's salary bracket: approximately ARS 10,000–30,000 per child per month in early 2025. Inversely proportional to salary — lower salaries receive higher amounts. For children under 18 in school.
aids.organisme: ANSES — Administración Nacional de la Seguridad Social

aids.description_en: Federal housing assistance program combining PROCREAR credit lines (subsidized mortgages through Banco Hipotecario) and FONAVI social housing construction. PROCREAR offers below-market-rate loans for first-time homebuyers with income below a variable threshold. The subsidy component varies by income bracket and property type. One-time benefit.
aids.organisme: Ministerio de Capital Humano / Banco Hipotecario
